description:
ARCHITECTURE CORRECTED by the maintainer 2026-09-04, replacing this bead's original framing.

The split is:
  * HEADLESS SIM  -> crates/outram-park-fork-dwsim-libs. The plant model itself (feed, column, cuts, step/snapshot) is headless and lives with the physics, NOT in an example.
  * EGUI COMPONENTS -> crates/outram-park-digital-twin-engine/src/components/, i.e. the LIBRARY, not an example tree.

My original wording scoped this as 'an examples/crude_sim_v1/ mirroring distillation_sim_v1', which put the plant model in the example. That is wrong for this workspace and is superseded.

The precedent to follow already exists: src/components/distillation_column.rs is an egui tray-stack widget in the dt-engine LIB, and its own header documents the pattern — a scalar-backed widget whose caller passes real state read from a DynamicColumnProfiles, never fabricated values. A crude column widget should follow that same shape (real per-stage temperatures and per-cut draw rates in, drawing out), and would plausibly extend or generalise that existing widget rather than duplicating it — check before adding a second tray-stack.

Note there is also an existing bead op-76hu, 'promote reactor models / widgets from examples into the digital-twin-engine library once V&V'd', which is the same direction of travel.

Still depends on the solve working: a widget fed a non-monotonic temperature profile would render a column that gets colder going down. Blocked behind op-190j.5.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content:
DONE 2026-09-04, to the architecture the maintainer specified.

HEADLESS PLANT -> crates/outram-park-fork-dwsim-libs/src/petroleum/crude_plant.rs, with the physics, not in an example. CrudePlant wraps DynamicColumn; new/with_inventory, step(CrudeCommands), snapshot() -> CrudeSnapshot (plain data: per-stage T, holdup, liquid/vapour flow, lightest-component profile, distillate, bottoms, and the cuts as (stage, rate, CrudeCut)). Reflux ratio and reboiler duty are manipulable; an out-of-range command returns the error and leaves the plant untouched, so a GUI slider cannot crash the sim.

Two things are DERIVED rather than invented, both after being caught getting it wrong:
  * the reboiler duty comes from the column's own steady solve, not a constant I picked;
  * the startup state is the steady profile, not a uniform fill. The benzene plant starts uniform on purpose so the transient is visible, but one composition repeated down a column spanning 200 K of boiling range is not a physical liquid anywhere and the energy balance said so.

EGUI -> extended components::DistillationColumnVisual rather than adding a second tray stack, as the bead asked. New optional side_draws: &[(usize, &str)] via with_side_draws, drawn as labelled arrows off the right edge; out-of-range stages are ignored, not clamped. from_scalars is unchanged, so the benzene sim's call site is untouched.

The two compose with no arithmetic between them — snap.cuts.iter().map(|(s,_,c)| (*s, c.label())) is exactly the shape with_side_draws wants — and there is a test in dt-engine asserting that, so the widget and the plant cannot drift apart silently.

Getting here needed one more defect fixed beyond op-190j.5: the dynamic column's interior-stage energy sweep divided by an absolute enthalpy and so was reference-state dependent, which made every crude distillate negative and the integration diverge. Filed and fixed as the sibling bead; the benzene V&V is unchanged by it.

4 plant tests + 2 widget tests. 682 lib tests pass, workspace builds release.

NOT DONE, deliberately: no GUI application. The bead scopes the plant and the components; wiring them into a runnable examples/crude_sim_v1 window is the obvious next step and is not claimed here.

title: crude sim: headless plant in dwsim + egui component in dt-engine lib

description:
STANDS ALONE AS OF 2026-09-12. This was previously tracked implicitly as the FHR ring-RPT residual's reproduction on a measured critical. That link is now BROKEN: the pebble residual was the F-19 sub-threshold inelastic bug (gh:#193, op-0iaq, commit 45f8d72d86), which closed it from +4004 to -469 pcm. LCT-008 contains no fluorine, and U-238/U-235/C-12/O-16/Li-7/Be-9/Si-28 all open their threshold sections at exactly 0.0 b, so LCT-008 was untouched by that fix and is a DIFFERENT, still-open defect with no bead of its own until now.

SYMPTOM. ICSBEP LEU-COMP-THERM-008, B&W critical lattices, 2.459 w/o UO2 rods in borated water, U-238 97.5% of heavy metal, 1.03 cm pellets (176 mfp across at 6.674 eV). An ICSBEP critical is k = 1.0000 by construction.
  case 1  1511 ppm B    4961 pins            +2950 +- 61 pcm
  case 2  1335.5 ppm B  4808 pins            +2271 +- 61 pcm
  case 8  794 ppm B     4808 pins + 144 pyrex +1713 +- 60 pcm
Spread 1237 +- 86 pcm = 14 sigma on cases sharing ONE pin cell. A pure cross-section error would give the same Delta-k everywhere; this tracks the poison.

WHAT IS ALREADY EXCLUDED (each by its own oracle):
  sigma_gamma(E) pointwise vs NJOY PENDF, 19 energies    +-0.04 %
  resonance SHAPE vs NJOY PENDF, 6 resonances            0.12 % worst
  infinitely-dilute RI vs NJOY PENDF + published         +0.00 %
  self-shielded ENERGY treatment vs exact slowing-down   worst 1.8 sigma
  SPATIAL self-shielding vs collision-probability oracle -32 +- 24 pcm, and the
                                                         sign is backwards (op-t9cr)
  geometry description vs the original MCNP deck         0 mismatches / 11025
  tracking method, delta vs surface-tracked CSG          18 pcm, 0.05 sigma
  fast physics / driver, Godiva + Jemima                 +57, +6 pcm
  thermal machinery, homogeneous, HEU-SOL-THERM-009      -18 pcm
  F-19 sub-threshold inelastic                           N/A - no fluorine here

METHOD THAT WORKED LAST TIME, use it again: PRICE mechanisms, do not check their accuracy. Run the case twice, once with the mechanism switched off. An accuracy statement bounds nothing; -4190 +- 335 pcm for 'inelastic, all nuclides' is what found the F-19 bug. Candidates to price here: B-10 thermal absorption treatment (the residual tracks boron), the pyrex/solid-poison path that case 8 adds, and H-in-H2O - note op-77pu (P0) has the H2O incoherent-inelastic kernel 2-5.5% too narrow vs NJOY THERMR, which is a CONFIRMED defect in the moderator of exactly this benchmark.

SIGN, stated first per op-exzh: we are HIGH, so the code under-absorbs somewhere. That it grows with boron concentration points at the absorber, not the fuel.

gh:#178 index. Paper dependency: this is Part II's headline open finding (docs/paper-datasets/part2-data-and-transport/).

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content: Possible bearing on the LCT-008 +2950 pcm: the H-in-H2O kernel defect this bead depends on (op-77pu) now has a likely root cause in op-ku5q / gh:#194 - the outgoing-energy law uses equiprobable discrete bins where NJOY THERMR adapts and interpolates. LCT-008's moderator is light water, so if op-ku5q is priced and lands, LCT-008 should be re-measured before any further hunting on it. Do not assume it closes the +2950 - price it.

title: outram-mc: LEU-COMP-THERM-008 reads +2950 +- 61 pcm against a measured critical — now a standalone defect

description: Scaffolded 2026-07-10 (src/incompressibles/): Incompressible enum + IncompressibleFluid poly-in-(T,x) data struct + rho/cp/lambda/mu/T(h) property fn stubs (todo!()). CoolProp IncompressibleBackend: coefficients are polynomials in temperature and composition x for pure incompressibles + mass/volume brines. Remaining: port the coefficient tables (codegen from reference/CoolProp/dev/incompressible_liquids + solutions) and implement the polynomial eval + h/s integrals + T-from-h inverse.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content: IMPLEMENTED 2026-07-10 (all 126 fluids, not just T66): wrote dev/gen_incompressible.py + dev/regen_incompressible_all.py (mirroring gen_fluid.py/regen_all.py). Covers all 5->4 needed fit forms (polynomial, exppolynomial, exponential, logexponential; polyoffset unused by any of the 126 surveyed). Split src/incompressibles/fluids.rs into a fluids/ dir (one file per fluid, like src/fluids/) + new fluid_enum.rs (generated Incompressible enum + data() dispatch, mirroring fluid.rs). Made conductivity+viscosity Option<PropertyFit> (renamed UnsupportedFitForm -> PropertyUnavailable) after discovering 4 fluids (Acetone, ExampleDigital, ExampleSolution, LiBr) carry an all-zero never-fit placeholder for one property in CoolProp's own JSON -- codegen detects is_all_zero() and emits None rather than a wrong 0.0. Verified: tests/incompressible_t66.rs (unchanged, still <1e-6) + new tests/all_incompressible_fluids_smoke.rs (all 126 fluids, midrange T/x, density/cp/enthalpy-roundtrip always; conductivity 122/126, viscosity 116/126 present). Bead can be closed.

title: Port CoolProp incompressible backend (INCOMP: pure + brines)

description: Trivial: read the file, print the inclusive 1-based line range [start, end] with line numbers, clamped to the file's actual length. No dependency at all -- pairs with 'cost'/'outline' as the third leg of the token-frugal 'cost -> outline -> slice' loop this epic (op-r8x3) is building.
title: kovan-cli: 'slice <file> <start> <end>' command (line-range read, no new dependency)
